description: This header file defines classes, enums, and functions related to legacy profiling in PyTorch's autograd profiler, including event representation, profiler control, and profiling guards.

classes.name: LegacyEvent
classes.description: Represents a profiling event with various attributes such as kind, name, thread ID, memory usage, and timing information.

classes.name: RangeEventList
classes.description: A thread-safe list to record and consolidate profiling events.

classes.name: ProfilerDisableOptions
classes.description: Controls options for disabling the profiler, such as cleanup and consolidation.

classes.name: RecordProfile
classes.description: Handles recording profiling data to a file or stream.

classes.name: TLSLegacyProfilerGuard
classes.description: A guard object that enables and disables the legacy profiler within a scope, optionally processing results via a callback.

methods.name: toIValue
methods.description: Serializes a LegacyEvent to an IValue for storage or transmission.

methods.name: fromIValue
methods.description: Deserializes an IValue back into a LegacyEvent.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records the event, optionally including CUDA information.

methods.name: kindStr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event kind.

methods.name: cudaElapsedUs
methods.description: Calculates elapsed CUDA time between events.

methods.name: updateMemoryStats
methods.description: Updates memory usage statistics based on device type.
